//: BUILD type-check config — used by `next build` via next.config.ts typescript.tsconfigPath. IDENTICAL to tsconfig.json except: tests/ and scripts/ are excluded from the BUILD type-check (they are never part of the server artifact, and type-checking them inside `next build` pushed builds past 4 GB on modest container hosts — measured: the build worker was SIGKILLed three times at ~2 GB heap on a 4 GB cgroup). The FULL repository (tests included) is type-checked by `bunx tsc --noEmit` on tsconfig.json as its own gate — CI runs it on every push, so this relocation is a memory fix, not a check removal.
